name: Keycloak
label: Keycloak Admin REST — customer realm users, groups, clients, tokens
description: Official Keycloak Admin REST (docs-api latest) plus realm OIDC token/introspect. Talks only to the operator’s customer-hosted realm — never the StudioQuack control-plane IdP. Auth: Bearer access_token for Admin REST. baseHost is host[:port] without scheme. Path vars use userId/clientUuid (hyphenated official names are mapped). Handler: OfficialApiNode. Never log access_token or credential values. listen is BPMN message-event ingress.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. Secrets stay in configurationParameters. Do not put access_token here.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Overrides config when non-blank. EXACT: create-user | get-user | list-users | update-user | delete-user | reset-password | create-group | list-groups | create-client | get-client | list-clients | create-role | assign-role | token-client-credentials | token-refresh | token-introspect | listen.

schema.label: userId
schema.description: User UUID path for get/update/delete/reset-password/assign-role.

schema.label: clientUuid
schema.description: Client internal UUID path for get-client (not clientId).

schema.label: username
schema.description: Username. create-user / update-user body; list-users query. Example: ada.

schema.label: email
schema.description: Email. create-user / update-user body; list-users query. Example: ada@example.com.

schema.label: name
schema.description: Group or role name; also client name. create-group / create-role / create-client.

schema.label: clientId
schema.description: Public clientId for create-client body and list-clients query.

schema.label: roles
schema.description: RoleRepresentation list for assign-role. Example: [{"id":"…","name":"user"}].

schema.label: search
schema.description: Search query for list-users / list-groups / list-clients.

schema.label: first
schema.description: Pagination offset for list-*. Example: 0.

schema.label: max
schema.description: Page size for list-*. Example: 50.

schema.label: grant_type
schema.description: OAuth grant for token-*. EXACT: client_credentials | refresh_token. Sent as form.

schema.label: scope
schema.description: OAuth scope form field for token-client-credentials / token-refresh.

schema.label: type
schema.description: Credential type for reset-password. Typical: password.

schema.label: temporary
schema.description: reset-password temporary flag. Official temporary.

schema.label: enabled
schema.description: Account enabled. Official enabled. create-user / update-user / list-users filter.

schema.label: firstName
schema.description: First name. Official UserRepresentation firstName. create-user / update-user / list-users.

schema.label: lastName
schema.description: Last name. Official UserRepresentation lastName.

schema.label: emailVerified
schema.description: Official emailVerified. create-user / update-user / list-users.

schema.label: attributes
schema.description: User or group attributes map. create-user / update-user / create-group / create-role.

schema.label: credentials
schema.description: CredentialRepresentation list for create-user. Example: [{"type":"password","value":"…","temporary":false}]. Never log.

schema.label: groups
schema.description: Group path strings for create-user. Example: ["/staff"].

schema.label: requiredActions
schema.description: Required actions. Official requiredActions. Example: ["UPDATE_PASSWORD"].

schema.label: exact
schema.description: Exact match flag for list-users / list-groups.

schema.label: q
schema.description: Attribute query q for list-users / list-groups / list-clients. Example: key:value.

schema.label: value
schema.description: New password value for reset-password. Never log.

schema.label: path
schema.description: Group path for create-group. Example: /staff.

schema.label: briefRepresentation
schema.description: list-groups briefRepresentation query.

schema.label: description
schema.description: Client or role description. create-client / create-role.

schema.label: protocol
schema.description: Client protocol. Typical: openid-connect. create-client.

schema.label: publicClient
schema.description: create-client publicClient.

schema.label: secret
schema.description: Client secret for create-client when not public. Never log.

schema.label: redirectUris
schema.description: create-client redirectUris. Example: ["https://app.example.com/*"].

schema.label: webOrigins
schema.description: create-client webOrigins.

schema.label: standardFlowEnabled
schema.description: create-client standardFlowEnabled.

schema.label: directAccessGrantsEnabled
schema.description: create-client directAccessGrantsEnabled.

schema.label: serviceAccountsEnabled
schema.description: create-client serviceAccountsEnabled.

schema.label: viewableOnly
schema.description: list-clients viewableOnly query.

schema.label: composite
schema.description: create-role composite.

schema.label: clientRole
schema.description: create-role clientRole.

schema.label: client_id
schema.description: OAuth client_id form field for token-*. Example: studioquack.

schema.label: client_secret
schema.description: OAuth client_secret form field for token-*. Prefer config when unused per call. Never log.

schema.label: refresh_token
schema.description: Refresh token for token-refresh. Never log.

schema.label: token
schema.description: Token to introspect for token-introspect. Never log.

schema.label: token_type_hint
schema.description: token-introspect hint. EXACT: access_token | refresh_token.

ports.name: output
ports.description: 2xx: status=ok, http_status, data. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: status
schema.description: Exact 'ok' on HTTP 2xx.

schema.label: http_status
schema.description: Upstream status code.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Parsed JSON. Do not log credentials, tokens, or client secrets.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default verb when input.operation is blank. listen is ingress. token-* hit the realm OIDC endpoints.

configurationParameters.label: Admin access token
configurationParameters.description: Bearer token with realm-management roles on the customer realm. StudioQuack secret. Never on INPUT or in logs. Required by OfficialApiNode for every verb including token-*.

configurationParameters.label: Keycloak host
configurationParameters.description: Host without scheme (and without /auth unless the deployment still uses the legacy context path). Example: idp.example.com or idp.example.com:8443. Customer realm host only.

configurationParameters.label: Realm
configurationParameters.description: Customer realm name (not id). Do not point this node at StudioQuack control-plane realms.
